goalZh: 听懂老师讲成绩怎么算,会用 due 问作业什么时候交
canDoZh: 能听懂老师讲课程要求,问清楚作业什么时候交、成绩怎么算

newItems.noteZh: 第一节课老师都会发 syllabus,写着成绩怎么算、作业什么时候交、有哪些规定;重音在前 SYL-la-bus。
写作课的作业多半是 essay;重音在前 ES-say,第二个音节读 /eɪ/。
The essay is due on Friday. 文章周五交;When is it due? 什么时候交?;美式读 /duː/,英式读 /djuː/。
美国大学的课程成绩用字母 A、B、C、D、F 表示;grade 在美国中小学还指"年级"。
40% 读 forty percent,percent 不加 s;重音在后 per-CENT。第 6 单元学过 percent off(减价百分之……)。
mid(中间)+ term(学期);期末考试叫 final;ter 卷舌 /ɝː/。
the final = the final exam;final 作形容词是"最后的"。词尾 l 舌尖抬起。

newItems.zh: 课堂参与(出勤、发言、讨论)
newItems.noteZh: 美国很多课的成绩里有一部分是 participation:来上课、发言、参加讨论;重音在 -PA- 上——以 -tion 结尾的词,重音落在 -tion 前面那个音节。

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: Welcome to Writing 2! This is our syllabus.
lines.zh: 欢迎来上写作 2!这是我们这门课的教学大纲。

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: You're going to write three essays. They're 40 percent of your grade.
lines.zh: 你们要写三篇文章,占成绩的 40%。

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: The midterm is 20 percent, and the final is 30 percent.
lines.zh: 期中考试占 20%,期末考试占 30%。

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: Good question! It means you come to class and talk in class.
lines.zh: 问得好!意思是你们每次都来上课,而且在课上发言。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have a question, too. When is the first essay due?
lines.zh: 我也有个问题。第一篇文章什么时候交?

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: It's due in three weeks, on Friday.

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: Please don't be late. It's 10 percent off for every day late.
lines.zh: 请不要晚交。每晚一天扣 10%。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ten percent a day? Wow. I'm never late!
lines.zh: 一天扣 10%?哇。我可从来不晚交!

questions.prompt: 三篇文章一共占成绩的百分之多少?
questions.explainZh: You're going to write three essays. They're 40 percent of your grade.——三篇文章占 40%;期中 20%,期末 30%,课堂参与 10%。

questions.prompt: 教授说的 participation 指的是什么?
questions.explainZh: 索菲亚问 What does "participation" mean?,教授回答 It means you come to class and talk in class.。

questions.prompt: 第一篇文章什么时候交?
questions.explainZh: It's due in three weeks, on Friday.——in three weeks 是"三周以后"。
It's 10 percent off for every day late.——每晚一天扣 10%,所以磊说 Ten percent a day?。

grammar.bodyZh: due 是形容词,意思是"到期的、应该交的",和 be 动词一起用:The essay is due on Friday.(文章周五交)/ When is the essay due?(文章什么时候交?)。说"多久以后交"用 in + 一段时间:It's due in three weeks.(三周以后交)。中文说"周五交作业",英语很少说 We give the essay on Friday,一般说 It's due on Friday.。美国老师很看重截止时间,晚交常常要扣分,拿到大纲先找 due 这个词。

examples.text: The first essay is due on Friday.

grammar.titleZh: 百分比和成绩:40 percent of your grade
grammar.bodyZh:
40% 读 forty percent,percent 不加 s(不说 forty percents)。说占成绩的多少:The essays are 40 percent of your grade.(文章占成绩的 40%)。晚交扣分可以说 10 percent off——第 6 单元学过打折的 percent off,这里是"扣掉 10%":It's 10 percent off for every day late.。课上有问题就说 I have a question.,老师常回一句 Good question!。
发音:participation 有五个音节 par-ti-ci-PA-tion,重音落在 -tion 前面那个音节上;以 -tion 结尾的词都这样:STA-tion、in-ter-NA-tion-al。

examples.text: Participation is 10 percent of your grade.
The midterm is 20 percent, and the final is 30 percent.
examples.zh: 期中考试占 20%,期末考试占 30%。

examples.text: It's 10 percent off for every day late.
